text:
Friendly hello support crew,
The lounge team reviewed a reminder about pet carriers at dawn

Please keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk aligned on carrier checks before any animal is accepted at the counter. The welfare coordinator expects calm handling, clear labeling, and steady updates in the desk ledger whenever service details change. <<FACT F030>> Staff should also confirm ventilation, secure fastenings, and clean interior lining before release to the traveler.

We also need consistent wording when we speak with crews on the floor. <<FACT F001>> Please pass along only practical instructions, avoid casual shorthand, and note any comfort concerns without delay. If a traveler arrives with a pet that seems stressed, route the matter through the proper review path and keep the exchange brief, courteous, and complete. Please maintain this standard across all shifts.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
